apple.subtitle: A journal for market sellers
apple.promotionalText: Keep the days behind every stall.
apple.description:
STALLIGHT DAYS is a journal for market sellers.

Keep track of the markets you apply to, your booth fees, and the sales you make. Record notes after each market and review how venues and products performed over time.

Built for independent makers, food trucks, night-market vendors, and sellers who move between regular and pop-up events. Features vary by plan.

Keep the days behind every stall.
